query:
SELECT ur.tenant_id AS "tenant_id!"
           FROM user_roles ur
           JOIN users u ON u.id = ur.user_id
           WHERE ur.user_id = $1 AND ur.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY ur.tenant_id = u.last_active_group_id DESC NULLS LAST,
                    ur.assigned_at DESC
           LIMIT 1
